description: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the ct0 request parameter of the delivery scripts is only required to start with http:// or https:// and is prepended unescaped to banner click URLs. description: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the zone banner-linking page (zone-include.php) does not cast the keys of the includebanner request array to integers. An authenticated manager, or a trafficker with the zone-linking permission, who owns the submitted website and zone can place SQL in an array key, which is concatenated unquoted into the banner-lookup query, resulting in time-based blind SQL injection bounded by the privileges of the application's database account.

title: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, unauthenticated request parameters in ad delivery can cause...
description: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, unauthenticated request parameters in ad delivery can cause reflected cross-site scripting. A crafted delivery URL places a macro token in the source or target parameter and malicious markup in the referer parameter. Macro replacement after initial input encoding can insert the unescaped markup into generated banner output, causing JavaScript execution in the delivery origin when a visitor follows the URL. An active banner is required.

title: CVE-2026-127231 - A double free in the X.509 name constraints enforcement of GnuTLS 3.8.13 on all platforms allows a r
description: A double free in the X.509 name constraints enforcement of GnuTLS 3.8.13 on all platforms allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service (application crash) via a certificate chain containing a NameConstraints extension processed while the application is under memory pressure. When an already populated name constraints object is reinitialized, previously freed list pointers are not cleared, so a memory allocation failure precisely at reinitialization leaves a dangling pointer that is freed again during a later cleanup.
